SELECT oi.order_id,
       SUM(p.product_price * CAST(oi.order_quantity AS REAL)) AS total_amount_eur
FROM Order_Items oi
JOIN Products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
GROUP BY oi.order_id
ORDER BY oi.order_id;

SELECT c.customer_id,
       c.customer_name,
       ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(p.product_price * CAST(oi.order_quantity AS REAL)), 0) * (1 +
            CASE
                WHEN TRIM(SUBSTR(a.address_details, INSTR(a.address_details, ',') + 2, 2)) = 'NV' THEN 0.0825
                WHEN TRIM(SUBSTR(a.address_details, INSTR(a.address_details, ',') + 2, 2)) = 'UT' THEN 0.0675
                -- Add other state mappings as needed
                ELSE 0
            END), 2) AS tax_adjusted_total_spend
FROM "Customers" c
JOIN "Addresses" a ON c.address_id = a.address_id
LEFT JOIN "Customer_Orders" co ON c.customer_id = co.customer_id
LEFT JOIN "Order_Items" oi ON co.order_id = oi.order_id
LEFT JOIN "Products" p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name;

WITH customer_spend AS (
    SELECT c.customer_id,
           COALESCE(SUM(p.product_price * CAST(oi.order_quantity AS INTEGER)), 0) AS total_spent
    FROM Customers c
    LEFT JOIN Customer_Orders co ON co.customer_id = c.customer_id
    LEFT JOIN Order_Items oi ON oi.order_id = co.order_id
    LEFT JOIN Products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
    GROUP BY c.customer_id
),
tiered AS (
    SELECT CASE
               WHEN total_spent >= 1000000 THEN 'Gold'
               WHEN total_spent >= 100000  THEN 'Silver'
               ELSE 'Bronze'
           END AS tier
    FROM customer_spend
)
SELECT tier, COUNT(*) AS count
FROM tiered
GROUP BY tier;

WITH CustomerSpending AS (
    SELECT 
        c.customer_id,
        SUM(CAST(oi.order_quantity AS REAL) * p.product_price) AS total_spending
    FROM Customers c
    JOIN Customer_Orders co ON c.customer_id = co.customer_id
    JOIN Order_Items oi ON co.order_id = oi.order_id
    JOIN Products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    GROUP BY c.customer_id
),
CustomerTiers AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        CASE 
            WHEN total_spending < 10000 THEN 'Bronze'
            WHEN total_spending BETWEEN 10000 AND 50000 THEN 'Silver'
            ELSE 'Gold'
        END AS loyalty_tier
    FROM CustomerSpending
)
SELECT 
    loyalty_tier,
    COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM CustomerTiers
GROUP BY loyalty_tier
ORDER BY 
    CASE loyalty_tier
        WHEN 'Bronze' THEN 1
        WHEN 'Silver' THEN 2
        WHEN 'Gold' THEN 3
    END

WITH customer_spend AS (
    SELECT c.customer_id,
           COALESCE(SUM(p.product_price * CAST(oi.order_quantity AS DOUBLE)), 0) AS total_spent
    FROM Customers c
    LEFT JOIN Customer_Orders co ON c.customer_id = co.customer_id
    LEFT JOIN Order_Items oi ON co.order_id = oi.order_id
    LEFT JOIN Products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    GROUP BY c.customer_id
)
SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN total_spent < 1000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bronze_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN total_spent >= 1000 AND total_spent < 5000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS silver_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN total_spent >= 5000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS gold_count
FROM customer_spend;

WITH customer_spend AS (
    SELECT
        c.customer_id,
        SUM(p.product_price * CAST(oi.order_quantity AS DOUBLE)) AS total_spend
    FROM Customers c
    JOIN Customer_Orders co ON c.customer_id = co.customer_id
    JOIN Order_Items oi ON co.order_id = oi.order_id
    JOIN Products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    GROUP BY c.customer_id
)
SELECT
    total_spend,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_spend DESC) AS spend_rank
FROM customer_spend
ORDER BY spend_rank;

SELECT
    p.product_type_code,
    SUM(p.product_price * CAST(oi.order_quantity AS REAL)) AS total_sales_amount
FROM Order_Items oi
JOIN Products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
GROUP BY p.product_type_code

WITH monthly_rates AS (
    SELECT year, month, average_rate
    FROM ExchangeRates
    WHERE year = 2022
),
sales_usd AS (
    SELECT
        p.product_type_code,
        CAST(strftime('%Y', o.order_date) AS INTEGER) AS order_year,
        CAST(strftime('%m', o.order_date) AS INTEGER) AS order_month,
        SUM(p.product_price * CAST(oi.order_quantity AS INTEGER)) AS total_usd
    FROM Order_Items oi
    JOIN Products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    JOIN Customer_Orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    GROUP BY p.product_type_code, order_year, order_month
)
SELECT
    s.product_type_code,
    SUM(s.total_usd * r.average_rate) AS total_sales_eur
FROM sales_usd s
JOIN monthly_rates r ON s.order_year = r.year AND s.order_month = r.month
GROUP BY s.product_type_code;

WITH sales AS (
    SELECT p.product_type_code,
           SUM(p.product_price * CAST(oi.order_quantity AS REAL)) AS total_sales
    FROM Products p
    JOIN Order_Items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
    GROUP BY p.product_type_code
)
SELECT product_type_code,
       total_sales
FROM sales
WHERE total_sales > (SELECT AVG(total_sales) FROM sales);

    SELECT 
        c.customer_id,
        c.customer_name,
        SUM(p.product_price * CAST(oi.order_quantity AS REAL)) AS total_usd
    FROM Customers AS c
    JOIN Customer_Orders AS co      ON c.customer_id = co.customer_id
    JOIN Order_Items    AS oi      ON co.order_id = oi.order_id
    JOIN Products       AS p       ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name
),
customer_eur AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        customer_name,
        total_usd * 0.85 AS total_eur          -- latest USD→EUR rate
    FROM customer_totals
)
SELECT
    customer_name,
    total_eur,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_eur DESC) AS rank
FROM customer_eur
ORDER BY total_eur DESC
LIMIT 5;

    SELECT 
        c.customer_name,
        SUM(p.product_price * CAST(oi.order_quantity AS REAL)) AS total_spent_usd

WITH customer_spend AS (
    SELECT
        c.customer_id,
        c.customer_name,
        c.customer_email,
        COALESCE(SUM(p.product_price * CAST(oi.order_quantity AS REAL)), 0) AS total_usd,
        MAX(co.order_date) AS latest_order_date
    FROM Customers c
    LEFT JOIN Customer_Orders co ON co.customer_id = c.customer_id
    LEFT JOIN Order_Items oi ON oi.order_id = co.order_id
    LEFT JOIN Products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
    GROUP BY c.customer_id
),
customer_tier AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        customer_name,
        customer_email,
        latest_order_date,
        total_usd * 0.9 AS total_eur,
        CASE
            WHEN total_usd * 0.9 > 20000 THEN 'Platinum'
            WHEN total_usd * 0.9 BETWEEN 10001 AND 20000 THEN 'Gold'
            WHEN total_usd * 0.9 BETWEEN 5001 AND 10000 THEN 'Silver'
            ELSE 'Bronze'
        END AS loyalty_tier
    FROM customer_spend
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        customer_name,
        customer_email,
        loyalty_tier,
        total_eur,
        latest_order_date,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY loyalty_tier ORDER BY latest_order_date DESC) AS rn
    FROM customer_tier
)
SELECT
    customer_name,
    customer_email,
    loyalty_tier,
    total_eur,
    latest_order_date
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 3
ORDER BY loyalty_tier, latest_order_date DESC;

FROM Customers c
JOIN Customer_Orders co ON c.customer_id = co.customer_id

GROUP BY c.customer_name;

SELECT c.customer_name,
       SUM(COALESCE(CAST(oi.order_quantity AS REAL), 0) * COALESCE(p.product_price, 0) * 0.9) AS total_eur_spent
FROM Customers c
JOIN Customer_Orders co ON c.customer_id = co.customer_id
JOIN Order_Items oi ON co.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN Products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name
ORDER BY total_eur_spent DESC;

votes.sql:
WITH first_orders AS (
    SELECT co.customer_id,
           co.order_id,
           co.order_date,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY co.customer_id ORDER BY co.order_date) AS rn
    FROM Customer_Orders AS co
)
SELECT c.customer_name
FROM Customers AS c
JOIN first_orders AS fo ON c.customer_id = fo.customer_id
JOIN Order_Items AS oi ON oi.order_id = fo.order_id
JOIN Products AS p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
WHERE fo.rn = 1
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name, fo.order_date
HAVING fo.order_date < '2000-01-01'
   AND SUM(p.product_price * CAST(oi.order_quantity AS DOUBLE)) >= 1000;

)

FROM Customers c

WITH customer_totals AS (
    SELECT
        c.customer_id,
        c.customer_name,
        MAX(co.order_date) AS most_recent_order,
        SUM(p.product_price * CAST(oi.order_quantity AS REAL)) * 1.07 * 0.85 AS total_eur
    FROM Customers c
    JOIN Customer_Orders co ON co.customer_id = c.customer_id
    JOIN Order_Items oi ON oi.order_id = co.order_id
    JOIN Products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
    GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name
)
SELECT
    customer_name,
    most_recent_order
FROM customer_totals
ORDER BY total_eur DESC
LIMIT 5;

JOIN CPI cp_year ON cp_year.year = CAST(strftime('%Y', co.order_date) AS INTEGER)
